title: World Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Awareness Day 2026
text:
UNIVERSITY NEWS & EVENTS

AWKUM Observes World Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Awareness Day 2026

23 November 2026

Department of Microbiology

BioBridge Society

The BioBridge Society, Department of Microbiology,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), organized

World Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Awareness
Day 2026
on 23 November 2026 to highlight
the growing global threat of antimicrobial resistance
and promote the responsible use of antibiotics and
other antimicrobial agents.

‹

›

1 / 11

Event Highlights | Department of Microbiology, AWKUM

Highlights of the Event

The programme featured a range of educational and
awareness activities designed to engage students,
faculty members, and young researchers.

AMR Awareness Talk

Expert insights and awareness sessions

Awareness Walk

Faculty and students spreading awareness

Research Poster Competition

Scientific ideas and research innovation

Promoting Responsible Antimicrobial Use

Experts highlighted the growing burden of antimicrobial
resistance, resistance mechanisms, antibiotic stewardship,
infection prevention and control, and the importance of
the
One Health approach
in addressing
this global challenge.

The awareness walk provided an opportunity for faculty
members and students to communicate the importance of
responsible antimicrobial use through banners and
placards. The research poster competition further
encouraged students and young researchers to showcase
innovative ideas and scientific contributions towards
combating antimicrobial resistance.

The initiative aimed to strengthen public awareness,
encourage responsible antimicrobial practices, promote
research innovation, and inspire collective action
against antimicrobial resistance.
